recognize_zh: 高倍下以各階段成熟的顆粒球系細胞（中晚幼粒、帶狀核、分葉核）為主，混有一些中型、染色質粗糙、核形略不規則的淋巴樣細胞；本圖形態本身不足以確立 T 細胞淋巴瘤，需免疫表型佐證。
features: Numerous maturing granulocytic cells: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils
Scattered small to medium mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin and slightly irregular nuclei, some possibly atypical lymphoid cells
Round erythroid precursors with dense chromatin
No definite population of large atypical cells in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows abundant maturing granulocytic elements with orderly progression to segmented neutrophils, along with erythroid precursors and an occasional eosinophil. Admixed are small to medium mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin and mildly irregular nuclear contours, which may represent atypical T cells, although they are not morphologically distinctive. Correlation with trephine biopsy immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, and T-cell receptor gene rearrangement studies is required to establish involvement by peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow lacks an aberrant T-cell population on flow cytometry and shows polyclonal TCR studies.
CML shows a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and BCR::ABL1, rather than atypical lymphoid infiltration.
Hematogones have smooth homogeneous chromatin and a maturing B-precursor immunophenotype, not a T-cell phenotype.
